gloss: source (of a signal, information, or transmission)

definitions.gloss: source (of a signal, information, or transmission)
definitions.explanation: The origin or starting point of a signal, message, broadcast, trend, or piece of information. Used both for technical transmissions and figuratively for the origin of ideas, trends, or rumors.

examples.japanese: {電波|でんぱ}の{発信源|はっしんげん}を{特定|とくてい}した。
examples.english: We identified the source of the signal.

examples.japanese: うわさの{発信源|はっしんげん}は{誰|だれ}だろう。
examples.english: I wonder who is the source of the rumor.

examples.japanese: あの{都市|とし}は{新|あたら}しいファッションの{発信源|はっしんげん}として{知|し}られている。
examples.english: That city is known as a source of new fashion trends.

notes:
{発信源|はっしんげん} combines {発信|はっしん} (transmission/broadcasting) and {源|げん} (source/origin).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {発信源|はっしんげん}を{特定|とくてい}する — to identify the source
- {発信源|はっしんげん}を{突|つ}き{止|と}める — to track down the source
- {情報|じょうほう}の{発信源|はっしんげん} — source of information
- トレンドの{発信源|はっしんげん} — source of trends

RELATED WORDS:
- {発信|はっしん} — transmission, broadcasting
- {震源|しんげん} — epicenter (of an earthquake)
- {感染源|かんせんげん} — source of infection
